name: pnpc-mcp-tally-prime
description: PNPC's connector for reading from and writing to TallyPrime (ledgers, vouchers, P&L, balance sheet, stock, SQL cache) directly from Claude.

tally_url.title: Tally Gateway URL
tally_url.description: TallyPrime's HTTP gateway address. Change the port here if you're running more than one Tally connector on this machine and need to avoid a port conflict (Tally's own default gateway port is 9000).

read_only_mode.title: Read-only mode
read_only_mode.description: When on, every write tool (create/update/delete) is blocked before it ever reaches Tally. Turn this on for anyone who should only ask questions, never change data.

disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools (advanced)
disabled_tools.description: Optional comma-separated exact tool names to block regardless of the read-only setting above, e.g. delete_voucher,delete_master to allow writes but forbid deletion. Leave blank to allow everything not already blocked by read-only mode.

tools.name: get_ledgers
tools.description: Get all ledgers (accounts) from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_stock_items
tools.description: Get all stock items from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_vouchers
tools.description: Get vouchers (Day Book) from TallyPrime filtered by date range

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get the currently open company info from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Get the Profit & Loss statement from TallyPrime for a date range

tools.name: get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Get the Balance Sheet from TallyPrime as of a given date

tools.name: get_trial_balance
tools.description: Get the Trial Balance from TallyPrime for a date range

tools.name: get_groups
tools.description: Get all account groups (e.g. Sundry Debtors, Fixed Assets) from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_voucher_types
tools.description: Get all voucher types configured in TallyPrime (e.g. Payment, Sales, Journal)

tools.name: get_cost_centres
tools.description: Get all cost centres from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_stock_summary
tools.description: Get the Stock Summary report from TallyPrime as of a given date

tools.name: get_bills_receivable
tools.description: Get outstanding Bills Receivable from TallyPrime as of a given date

tools.name: get_bills_payable
tools.description: Get outstanding Bills Payable from TallyPrime as of a given date

tools.name: get_ledger_vouchers
tools.description: Get all voucher entries posted to a specific ledger within a date range

tools.name: create_ledger
tools.description: Create a new ledger in TallyPrime, or rename/update an existing one by passing oldName

tools.name: delete_master
tools.description: Delete one or more masters (ledger, group, stock item, voucher type, unit, godown, cost centre, etc.) from TallyPrime by name

tools.name: set_company
tools.description: Switch TallyPrime's active company context

tools.name: set_period
tools.description: Switch TallyPrime's active reporting period (from/to date)

tools.name: create_voucher
tools.description: Create a new voucher (e.g. Payment, Receipt, Sales, Purchase, Journal) in TallyPrime, with 2 or more ledger entries

tools.name: create_stock_journal
tools.description: Create a Stock Journal or Manufacturing Journal voucher in TallyPrime, moving inventory from one or more source items to one or more destination items

tools.name: update_stock_journal
tools.description: Update an existing Stock Journal or Manufacturing Journal voucher in TallyPrime

tools.name: set_bill_of_materials
tools.description: Attach a Bill of Materials (recipe) to a finished-goods stock item in TallyPrime

tools.name: create_material_in
tools.description: Create a Material In voucher in TallyPrime, recording stock received back from a job worker

tools.name: create_material_out
tools.description: Create a Material Out voucher in TallyPrime, recording stock sent out to a job worker

tools.name: create_rejections_in
tools.description: Create a Rejections In voucher in TallyPrime, recording goods rejected and returned to you

tools.name: create_rejections_out
tools.description: Create a Rejections Out voucher in TallyPrime, recording goods you're rejecting and returning outward

tools.name: create_physical_stock
tools.description: Create a Physical Stock voucher in TallyPrime, recording a physical stock count

tools.name: update_physical_stock
tools.description: Update an existing Physical Stock voucher in TallyPrime

tools.name: create_sales_invoice
tools.description: Create an item-invoice Sales voucher in TallyPrime with stock item lines and optional VAT

tools.name: update_sales_invoice
tools.description: Update an existing item-invoice Sales voucher in TallyPrime

tools.name: create_purchase_invoice
tools.description: Create an item-invoice Purchase voucher in TallyPrime with stock item lines and optional VAT

tools.name: update_purchase_invoice
tools.description: Update an existing item-invoice Purchase voucher in TallyPrime

tools.name: create_credit_note
tools.description: Create an item-invoice Credit Note (Sales return) in TallyPrime

tools.name: update_credit_note
tools.description: Update an existing item-invoice Credit Note in TallyPrime

tools.name: create_debit_note
tools.description: Create an item-invoice Debit Note (Purchase return) in TallyPrime

tools.name: update_debit_note
tools.description: Update an existing item-invoice Debit Note in TallyPrime

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a new account group in TallyPrime, or rename/reparent an existing one by passing oldName

tools.name: create_stock_group
tools.description: Create a new Stock Group in TallyPrime, nested under a parent stock group

tools.name: create_unit
tools.description: Create a new simple or compound Unit of Measure in TallyPrime

tools.name: create_godown
tools.description: Create a new Godown/Location in TallyPrime, optionally nested under a parent godown

tools.name: create_cost_category
tools.description: Create a new Cost Category in TallyPrime

tools.name: create_cost_centre
tools.description: Create a new Cost Centre in TallyPrime

tools.name: create_voucher_type
tools.description: Create a new custom Voucher Type in TallyPrime, or rename/reconfigure an existing one

tools.name: create_stock_item
tools.description: Create a new stock item in TallyPrime

tools.name: update_stock_item
tools.description: Update the group and/or unit of an existing stock item in TallyPrime

tools.name: delete_stock_item
tools.description: Delete a stock item from TallyPrime. Fails if it has transactions posted against it.

tools.name: update_voucher
tools.description: Update an existing voucher in TallyPrime, replacing its ledger entries and narration

tools.name: delete_voucher
tools.description: Permanently delete an existing voucher from TallyPrime, with no trace left behind

tools.name: sync_to_sql
tools.description: Pull ledgers, groups, and stock items into this session's in-memory SQL cache for fast ad-hoc querying

tools.name: sync_vouchers_to_sql
tools.description: Pull voucher headers for one date range into this session's in-memory SQL cache

tools.name: query_sql
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT query against the local cache populated by sync_to_sql

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Read this connector's append-only audit log of every tool call made through it
